# anxcloud_kubernetes_kubeconfig (Data Source)

Retrieves an existing Kubernetes kubeconfig without requesting, regenerating, or removing it.

The cluster must already have a kubeconfig. Use the `anxcloud_kubernetes_kubeconfig` resource separately when a kubeconfig first needs to be requested. Unlike that resource, removing this data source from configuration does not remove the remote kubeconfig.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anxcloud_kubernetes_cluster" "example" {
  name            = "example-cluster"
  api_environment = "prod"
}

data "anxcloud_kubernetes_kubeconfig" "example" {
  cluster         = data.anxcloud_kubernetes_cluster.example.id
  api_environment = "prod"
}

provider "kubernetes" {
  host                   = data.anxcloud_kubernetes_kubeconfig.example.host
  token                  = data.anxcloud_kubernetes_kubeconfig.example.token
  cluster_ca_certificate = data.anxcloud_kubernetes_kubeconfig.example.cluster_ca_certificate
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster` (String) Cluster identifier.

### Optional

- `api_environment` (String) Kubernetes service environment. Valid values are `prod`, `stage`, and `dev`; defaults to `prod`. Use the same value for a cluster and its node pools and kubeconfigs. For managed resources, changing it recreates the resource because it selects a different API endpoint.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_ca_certificate` (String, Sensitive) Kubeconfig cluster ca certificate.
- `host` (String) Cluster control-plane host.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `raw` (String, Sensitive) Raw kubeconfig.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Kubeconfig token.
